notes.content: minimum grade of c- in MAJOR courses

Students must earn a "C-" or better in all required courses for the major that have a KINS, ZOOL, REC or HED prefix (or their equivalent, in the case of courses transferred from another institution), and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.
